coverage: 14 valid GSC days per window; future coverage for label only
label: outcome_impressions < 0.8 * past_impressions
quality_change: Daily position <1 becomes missing, motivated by Week 4 review before June was read; row eligibility unchanged.
missing_values: Median imputation fitted only on March development clients; no extra features
internal_validation: 5-fold GroupKFold on March development clients, no model selection or parameter search
baseline: Frozen volume_first_v1: score = past_impressions; deterministic client/content key tiebreak
primary_final_cohort: June labeled pages belonging to the original March holdout clients; never trained on these clients
secondary_cohort: All June labeled pages, explicitly mixed seen/unseen clients
primary_metric: decline-proxy precision@20 difference: model minus baseline on identical cohort
uncertainty: 500 paired client-bootstrap resamples on primary final cohort, recomputing global top20; descriptive percentile interval with few clusters
decision_policy: Keep baseline if final model precision@20 does not exceed baseline; any observed lift remains decision-support, not refresh benefit.
no_adaptation: Do not tune model, features, eligibility, label, ranking tie policy or thresholds after observing June.
recommendations: Historical June 17 queue for final holdout clients based on past data only, including unknown outcomes; inspect before editing.
